tests: Verify that delayed or hung getVisualPageHistory does not block the React save transition and releases Save button immediately
Verify that rapid sequential saves (e.g. v2 then v3) succeed with exact 2 write operations
Verify that when v3 history resolves before late v2 history, late v2 history is ignored and history list displays current v3 revision
Verify that late history resolving after document id or owner switch (ownerIdRef.current !== savedOwnerId) is discarded without error or state corruption
Verify that synchronous throw or network rejection in fire-and-forget history fetch does not trigger save error notice or clobber draft states
